scope: Bind an explicit frozen schema-2 recipe to a checked catalog-owned project without a synthetic branch, schema-4 profile, dependency mutation or native execution.

source_witness.raw_identity: The module checks the unchanged compiled recipe document, original raw schema-2 lock and uniquely selected exact-copy role inputs. No historical source lookup or normalization is performed.

api.checked_owner: CatalogOwnedProject has private fields and verifies exact current catalog, metadata, context, authored/generated membership, selected bytes and provenance. This slice consumes that handle; it does not clone Check/Apply policy.
api.recipe: An exact reviewed recipe ID is required. The target, actual Minecraft version, compiler release and loader must match the checked receipt. There is no default recipe or parsing of key spelling.
api.bindings: sfm-toolchain.lock.json must be an exact copy of the recipe's original source_path. All thirteen role inputs resolve through exact_authored_input(source_path), which requires one selected output with equal raw/output bytes. Output names are not inferred from the first three review rows, which omit output fields.
api.dependencies: One private Arc<PreparedDependencyInputs> retains original ordered rows, pins, provenance, frozen aliases, source exclusions and strict request identity. Existing ReleasedNativeInputs performs all role/Gradle-line/artifact checks and exact weak-byte promotion.
api.receipt: FrozenRecipeProjectReceipt nests portable checked-owner, released-input and prepared-input receipts, exact selected role/lock bindings, compiler_release, tool_jvm_minimum and explicit non-build/external-effect gates. jdk_identity is None: actual JDK selection remains a later independently verified input.
api.recheck: FrozenRecipeProject::recheck(refresh) rejects refresh first, rechecks current project ownership, verifies raw source-lock bytes against the prepared handle and compares every role binding. It is not a filesystem lock or execution permit.
api.cache: preparation_identity hashes exact key/environment/context, owner/source/provenance, recipe, lock, request catalog and compiler/tool boundary. preparation_cache_relative_path returns a relative name only, never creates it, and is not a complete build-cache identity before the actual JDK/tool identities are added.

weak_boundary.behavior: Both 26.1.2 release/dev fixtures refuse absent exact bytes. A caller may provide bytes only for the original reviewed weak-artifact indexes; existing promotion verifies the unchanged original pin. There is no local-cache discovery, replacement checksum, truncated-metadata acceptance or download route.
weak_boundary.separate_existing_evidence: docs/tasks/sfm-core-native-artifact-identity-proof.json records root-owned read-only actual-byte evidence. This new module's fixtures do not embed or acquire those artifacts and do not claim positive 26.1.2 native preparation/build proof.

fixture_contract.owner: New catalog_owned_project::tests::Fixture is shared only under cfg(test).
fixture_contract.contexts: Ten supported target identities and actual Minecraft values, each with a synthetic nested release and ignored-dev key; release/dev feature differences remain explicit fixture context. These are ownership/preparation fixtures, not a claim that all current gameplay features compile.
fixture_contract.real_inputs: Exact thirteen frozen role bytes and the original schema-2 lock are read from existing core-owned sources. Real current CoreProjectInputs selectors determine unique role output bindings. Only the selected target's fixture mappings are replaced; other target predicates remain intact.
fixture_contract.expected_matrix: Eighteen non-weak contexts prepare; two 26.1.2 contexts refuse missing original exact-byte evidence. Project file hashes and absence of build/cache directories are checked before and after preparation/refusal.
fixture_contract.specific_regressions: The stable target 1.21.0 uses actual Minecraft 1.21 and dependency/java-toolchain output directories named 1.21. The 1.19.4 recipe keeps Forge 45.0.9 and refuses 45.0.42. Java --release 17 is not changed to 21 merely because NeoGradle tools need Java 21.

validation_performed.rustfmt: Scoped rustfmt --edition 2024 on this new module completed; installed stable rustfmt reported unsupported imports_granularity/group_imports settings. No Cargo command was run by this agent.
validation_performed.json: The integration review parsed as JSON with ten target rows. New slice JSON parsing/hash verification is performed at handoff.
validation_performed.binding_reconnaissance: Read-only current metadata confirmed the thirteen 1.21.0 source-to-output bindings, including the actual 1.21 directory aliases, all template:false.
validation_performed.run_status: Unregistered. No unit test, compile, source acquisition, native JAR, launch, cache repair, JDK resolution or lock write was performed by this agent. Root owns registration and focused/full gates.

next_integration: Root registers catalog_owned_project and frozen_recipe_project together after its active gate, then runs the ten bounded preparation tests and shared ownership tests.
Later engine routing distinguishes a real catalog-owned named target from WorktreeTarget/BranchName. Prepared inputs propagate to the opt-in strict Resolver and immutable source-lock writer refusal.
Before any effects, shared named Check and source membership must be current; release never auto-syncs and dev uses only the established guarded ignored root workflow.

Native execution remains refused until direct version-JSON children/pipeline consumers, external NeoForm manifest closure, source-build misses, actual JDK identity and frozen runtime/JUnit consumers are sealed. The 541 preserved unexpanded pipeline roles are not claimed exercised.
unchanged: Existing registered Rust, source templates, catalog, feature definitions and core metadata were not edited by this slice.
No Cargo/Gradle/SFM toolchain dependency, original schema-2 lock or provenance was changed.
No build, acquisition, game process, cache cleanup, process termination, installation or commit was performed.
